name: galgame-companion
//: RELEASE RULE: the version, the git tag and the jsDelivr pin move TOGETHER. On every bump: set the pin to @v<version> in README.md (Install) and galgame-companion.import.json, commit, tag that commit v<version>, push the commit AND the tag. jsDelivr serves dist/ from the tag, so a bump with no tag ships nothing, and a stale pin keeps every card on the old build.
